title: Classical context for the plane stable-coordinate boundary
publication: The stable equivalence and cancellation problems, Comment. Math. Helv. 79 (2004), 341-349
inspected_location: Theorem 1.1, printed page 342; definitions of stable equivalence and stable coordinate immediately before and after it
role: Classical context and attribution only: plane stable equivalence implies plane equivalence. The needed Keller stable-coordinate implication is proved from retained smooth-curve Hodge data and the affine-line endpoint, without importing Theorem 1.1 as an unproved classification.
